title: Earthy Savory Croatian Cheese Flatbread
description: This lacto-vegetarian-friendly dish features a salty and crumbly Croatian cheese flatbread, perfect for a date night, with flavors of garlic and wok-hei. The combination of ingredients creates a delicious and savory taste experience.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine flour, salt, and yeast.
Gradually add water and olive oil to the dry ingredients and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with a damp cloth, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Preheat the oven to 425 degrees Fahrenheit.
Punch down the dough and roll it out into a thin circle, about 1/4 inch thick.
Spread the minced garlic clove over the dough, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Crumble the Croatian cheese over the garlic.
Drizzle the wok-hei oil over the cheese.
Sprinkle chopped parsley over the top.
Bake the flatbread in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until it is golden brown and crispy.
